title: FieldPoly div_rem, gcd, Horner eval, Karatsuba multiplication
description:
Complete single-pair polynomial algebra on `FieldPoly<F>` from the core type landed in the previous task.

## Scope

- `div_rem(&self, &Self) -> (Self, Self)` with `deg(r) < deg(divisor)` invariant (panics on divisor zero). Operator overloads `Div` and `Rem` built on top.
- `gcd(a, b) -> Self` via Euclidean algorithm; returns a **monic** result (divide by leading coefficient).
- `evaluate(&self, point: &F) -> F` using Horner's method.
  - **Convention**: empty (zero) polynomial evaluates to zero. Document prominently; this differs from `Gf2mPoly::eval` which panics on empty input. Project lead approved `zero-returns-zero` to compose with the subproduct tree (Task 3).
- Upgrade `mul` to Karatsuba with a named `const KARATSUBA_THRESHOLD: usize = 32` cut-off matching `Gf2mPoly::mul_karatsuba`. Retain the schoolbook path and dispatch by size.
- Op-count test (analogous to `batch_ops::OpCount`) asserting Karatsuba drops below schoolbook multiplication counts at `n >= 64`.

## Success criteria

- Proptests: `(a*b) / b == a` for non-zero `b`; `gcd(a, b)` divides both `a` and `b`; `evaluate` vs naive sum-of-terms agrees.
- Unit tests: hand-computed `div_rem` and `gcd` examples; `evaluate(zero_poly, anything) == zero`.
- `cargo fmt`, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo test --release` all clean.
- Every public item doc-commented per project conventions; doctests runnable.
